image_description: A wide-angle interior shot of a church sanctuary, featuring a central red carpet leading to a raised altar area. The altar is a white rectangular structure draped in cloth, positioned under a large stone arch. A black chandelier hangs above. In the foreground, there are wooden pews and a person standing on the left. Text at the bottom reads 'nave central de la iglesia de puente Viesgo' and 'SIARCO 10'.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'nave central de la iglesia de puente Viesgo' exhibits characteristic AI font inconsistencies. The letters are unevenly spaced, some characters are malformed (e.g., the 'g' in iglesia, the 'V' in Viesgo), and the baseline wavers slightly. It mimics text but lacks the crisp vector quality of real typography.

The chandelier lacks distinct individual bulbs or structural arms. It appears as a fused, melted mass of black shapes with glowing spots, failing to resolve into a coherent mechanical object upon close inspection.
The decorative blind arches in the background apse show slight perspective warping and inconsistent depth. Some arches seem to merge into the wall rather than receding properly.
